instruction:
Create a 3D model of a circuit board. 

The board should be rectangular with various electronic components. 

Include resistors, capacitors, and integrated circuits. 

Add a few LEDs for visual indication. 

Finally, place connectors on the edges for external connections.

Layer 0 – Root
| ID | Description | Key attributes / placement |
|---|---|---|
| pcb_base | Composite of substrate + copper traces + vias | A. Rectangular substrate 0.150×0.100×0.002 m; B. Copper trace layer (boolean_subtract from substrate or additive layer, simplified here as part of base); C. Vias (cylinders piercing through). mat=board_green; create_method=primitive; pos=(0,0,0); orientation=axis:+Z; assembly_order=[pcb_base] |

Layer 1 – Primary Structure (Substrate & Traces)
| ID | Description | Key attributes / placement |
|---|---|---|
| substrate | Rectangular PCB substrate | cylinder Ø0.150×0.100×0.002 m (approximated as cuboid for simplicity in description, but using cuboid primitive). size=0.150×0.100×0.002 m. mat=board_green; create_method=cube; pos=(0,0,0); orientation=axis:+Z; assembly_order=[pcb_base] |
| copper_layer | Copper trace pattern on top surface | boolean_subtract or additive layer. For simplicity, represented as a thin plate on top. size=0.150×0.100×0.00005 m. mat=via_copper; create_method=cube; pos=(0,0,0.001); orientation=axis:+Z; assembly_order=[pcb_base] |
| via_1 | Via hole 1 | cylinder Ø0.002×0.002 m. mat=via_copper; create_method=cylinder; pos=(-0.05, -0.03, 0); orientation=axis:+Z; assembly_order=[pcb_base] |
| via_2 | Via hole 2 | cylinder Ø0.002×0.002 m. mat=via_copper; create_method=cylinder; pos=(0.05, 0.03, 0); orientation=axis:+Z; assembly_order=[pcb_base] |

Layer 2 – Integrated Circuits
| ID | Description | Key attributes / placement |
|---|---|---|
| ic_1 | Main Microcontroller IC | cuboid 0.040×0.040×0.005 m. mat=ic_black; create_method=cube; pos=(-0.03, 0.02, 0.0035); orientation=axis:+Z; assembly_order=[ic_group] |
| ic_2 | Secondary Logic IC | cuboid 0.020×0.020×0.004 m. mat=ic_black; create_method=cube; pos=(0.03, -0.02, 0.003); orientation=axis:+Z; assembly_order=[ic_group] |
| ic_group | Composite of ICs | Composite of ic_1 + ic_2; placed on PCB. assembly_order=[ic_group] |

Layer 3 – Passive Components (Resistors & Capacitors)
| ID | Description | Key attributes / placement |
|---|---|---|
| resistor_1 | Surface Mount Resistor | cuboid 0.006×0.003×0.003 m. mat=resistor_body; create_method=cube; pos=(-0.08, 0.04, 0.0025); orientation=axis:+Z; assembly_order=[passive_group] |
| resistor_2 | Surface Mount Resistor | cuboid 0.006×0.003×0.003 m. mat=resistor_body; create_method=cube; pos=(0.08, -0.04, 0.0025); orientation=axis:+Z; assembly_order=[passive_group] |
| capacitor_1 | Ceramic Capacitor | cuboid 0.005×0.005×0.004 m. mat=resistor_body (often same color); create_method=cube; pos=(-0.06, -0.04, 0.003); orientation=axis:+Z; assembly_order=[passive_group] |
| capacitor_2 | Ceramic Capacitor | cuboid 0.005×0.005×0.004 m. mat=resistor_body; create_method=cube; pos=(0.06, 0.04, 0.003); orientation=axis:+Z; assembly_order=[passive_group] |
| passive_group | Composite of Passives | Composite of resistor_1 + resistor_2 + capacitor_1 + capacitor_2; placed on PCB. assembly_order=[passive_group] |

Layer 4 – LEDs
| ID | Description | Key attributes / placement |
|---|---|---|
| led_1 | Red LED | cylinder Ø0.004×0.003 m (domed top approximated). mat=led_red; create_method=cylinder; pos=(-0.05, 0.06, 0.0025); orientation=axis:+Z; assembly_order=[led_group] |
| led_2 | Red LED | cylinder Ø0.004×0.003 m. mat=led_red; create_method=cylinder; pos=(0.05, -0.06, 0.0025); orientation=axis:+Z; assembly_order=[led_group] |
| led_group | Composite of LEDs | Composite of led_1 + led_2; placed on PCB. assembly_order=[led_group] |

Layer 5 – Connectors
| ID | Description | Key attributes / placement |
|---|---|---|
| conn_1 | USB Type-C Connector | cuboid 0.030×0.010×0.008 m. mat=connector_gold; create_method=cube; pos=(0, -0.045, 0.005); orientation=axis:+Z; assembly_order=[connector_group] |
| conn_2 | Header Pin Block | cuboid 0.020×0.010×0.006 m. mat=connector_gold; create_method=cube; pos=(0, 0.045, 0.005); orientation=axis:+Z; assembly_order=[connector_group] |
| connector_group | Composite of Connectors | Composite of conn_1 + conn_2; placed on PCB edges. assembly_order=[connector_group] |

# ----------  END_GRAPH  ----------

import bpy
import bmesh
import mathutils
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix

# --- Helper Functions ---

def make_material(name, diffuse_color):
    """Create a new Principled BSDF material."""
    mat = bpy.data.materials.new(name=name)
    mat.use_nodes = True
    bsdf = mat.node_tree.nodes["Principled BSDF"]
    bsdf.inputs['Base Color'].default_value = diffuse_color
    return mat

def add_primitive(name, shape, size=None, diameter=None, height=None, location=(0,0,0), rotation=(0,0,0)):
    """Add a primitive mesh object."""
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=location)
    obj = bpy.context.active_object
    obj.name = name
    obj.rotation_euler = rotation
    
    if shape == 'cube':
        obj.scale = (size[0]/2, size[1]/2, size[2]/2)
    elif shape == 'cylinder':
        # Cylinder default is radius, height
        r = diameter / 2 if diameter else 0.5
        h = height if height else 1.0
        obj.scale = (r, r, h)
    elif shape == 'disc':
        r = diameter / 2 if diameter else 0.5
        h = height if height else 0.01
        obj.scale = (r, r, h)
    elif shape == 'cone':
        r = diameter / 2 if diameter else 0.5
        h = height if height else 1.0
        obj.scale = (r, r, h)
    elif shape == 'sphere':
        r = diameter / 2 if diameter else 0.5
        obj.scale = (r, r, r)
        
    return obj

def align_face_to_face(obj_top, obj_bottom, offset_z=0):
    """Align obj_top's bottom face to obj_bottom's top face, then apply Z offset."""
    # Get bounding boxes
    min_b, max_b = obj_bottom.bound_box, obj_top.bound_box
    
    # Calculate world coordinates of faces
    # Assuming standard orientation where Z is up
    # Bottom face of top object
    # Top face of bottom object
    
    # We need to move obj_top so its lowest Z matches obj_bottom's highest Z
    # But we must respect local transforms. Simplest is to use world coords.
    
    # Get world matrix
    mat_bottom = obj_bottom.matrix_world
    mat_top = obj_top.matrix_world
    
    # Local min/max Z
    min_z_bottom = min([v[2] for v in min_b])
    max_z_bottom = max([v[2] for v in max_b])
    
    min_z_top = min([v[2] for v in min_b])
    max_z_top = max([v[2] for v in max_b])
    
    # World Z of bottom object's top face
    world_z_bottom_top = mat_bottom.translation.z + max_z_bottom
    
    # World Z of top object's bottom face (before move)
    world_z_top_bottom = mat_top.translation.z + min_z_top
    
    # Delta to align
    delta_z = world_z_bottom_top - world_z_top_bottom + offset_z
    
    obj_top.location.z += delta_z
    
    return obj_top

def align_center_to_center(obj_target, obj_source):
    """Align obj_source center to obj_target center."""
    mat_target = obj_target.matrix_world
    mat_source = obj_source.matrix_world
    
    center_target = mat_target.translation
    center_source = mat_source.translation
    
    delta = center_target - center_source
    obj_source.location += delta
    
    return obj_source

def apply_boolean_union(target, cutter):
    """Apply a boolean union modifier and apply it."""
    # Ensure target is active
    bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active = target
    bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT')
    target.select_set(True)
    
    # Add modifier
    mod = target.modifiers.new(name="BooleanUnion", type='BOOLEAN')
    mod.operation = 'UNION'
    mod.object = cutter
    
    # Apply
    bpy.ops.object.modifier_apply(modifier=mod.name)
    
    # Remove cutter if desired, or keep it. Usually keep for debugging, but let's remove to clean up.
    bpy.data.objects.remove(cutter, do_unlink=True)

def apply_boolean_subtract(target, cutter):
    """Apply a boolean subtract modifier and apply it."""
    bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active = target
    bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT')
    target.select_set(True)
    
    mod = target.modifiers.new(name="BooleanSub", type='BOOLEAN')
    mod.operation = 'DIFFERENCE'
    mod.object = cutter
    
    bpy.ops.object.modifier_apply(modifier=mod.name)
    
    bpy.data.objects.remove(cutter, do_unlink=True)

# --- Block 0: Scene Reset & Units ---

# Delete all existing objects
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='SELECT')
bpy.ops.object.delete(use_global=False)

# Set units to metres
bpy.context.scene.unit_settings.scale_length = 1.0
bpy.context.scene.unit_settings.system = 'METRIC'

# --- Block 1: Materials ---

mat_board_green = make_material("board_green", (0.1, 0.4, 0.1, 1.0))
mat_connector_gold = make_material("connector_gold", (0.8, 0.6, 0.1, 1.0))
mat_ic_black = make_material("ic_black", (0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 1.0))
mat_led_red = make_material("led_red", (0.8, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0))
mat_resistor_body = make_material("resistor_body", (0.8, 0.6, 0.4, 1.0))
mat_resistor_lead = make_material("resistor_lead", (0.7, 0.7, 0.7, 1.0))
mat_via_copper = make_material("via_copper", (0.8, 0.5, 0.1, 1.0))

# --- Block 2: Geometry Generation ---

# SECTION 1 – Create PCB Substrate and Base Layer

# 1.1 Create substrate
substrate = add_primitive("substrate", "cube", size=(0.150, 0.100, 0.002), location=(0,0,0), rotation=(0,0,0))
substrate.data.materials.append(mat_board_green)

# 1.2 Create copper_layer
copper_layer = add_primitive("copper_layer", "cube", size=(0.150, 0.100, 0.00005), location=(0,0,0), rotation=(0,0,0))
copper_layer.data.materials.append(mat_via_copper)

# Align copper_layer to substrate
align_face_to_face(copper_layer, substrate, offset_z=0.001)

# 1.3 Create via_1
via_1 = add_primitive("via_1", "cylinder", diameter=0.002, height=0.002, location=(0,0,0), rotation=(0,0,0))
via_1.data.materials.append(mat_via_copper)

# Anchor via_1 to substrate (center-to-center)
align_center_to_center(substrate, via_1)
# Offset via_1
via_1.location.x -= 0.05
via_1.location.y -= 0.03

# 1.4 Create via_2
via_2 = add_primitive("via_2", "cylinder", diameter=0.002, height=0.002, location=(0,0,0), rotation=(0,0,0))
via_2.data.materials.append(mat_via_copper)

# Anchor via_2 to substrate
align_center_to_center(substrate, via_2)
# Offset via_2
via_2.location.x += 0.05
via_2.location.y += 0.03

# 1.5 Boolean Unions
apply_boolean_union(substrate, via_1)
apply_boolean_union(substrate, via_2)
apply_boolean_union(substrate, copper_layer)

# SECTION 2 – Create Integrated Circuits

# 2.1 Create ic_1
ic_1 = add_primitive("ic_1", "cube", size=(0.040, 0.040, 0.005), location=(0,0,0), rotation=(0,0,0))
ic_1.data.materials.append(mat_ic_black)

# Align ic_1 to substrate
align_face_to_face(ic_1, substrate, offset_z=0.0035)
# Offset ic_1
ic_1.location.x -= 0.03
ic_1.location.y += 0.02

# 2.2 Create ic_2
ic_2 = add_primitive("ic_2", "cube", size=(0.020, 0.020, 0.004), location=(0,0,0), rotation=(0,0,0))
ic_2.data.materials.append(mat_ic_black)

# Align ic_2 to substrate
align_face_to_face(ic_2, substrate, offset_z=0.003)
# Offset ic_2
ic_2.location.x += 0.03
ic_2.location.y -= 0.02

# SECTION 3 – Create Passive Components

# 3.1 Create resistor_1
resistor_1 = add_primitive("resistor_1", "cube", size=(0.006, 0.003, 0.003), location=(0,0,0), rotation=(0,0,0))
resistor_1.data.materials.append(mat_resistor_body)

# Align resistor_1 to substrate
align_face_to_face(resistor_1, substrate, offset_z=0.0025)
# Offset resistor_1
resistor_1.location.x -= 0.08
resistor_1.location.y += 0.04

# 3.2 Create resistor_2
resistor_2 = add_primitive("resistor_2", "cube", size=(0.006, 0.003, 0.003), location=(0,0,0), rotation=(0,0,0))
resistor_2.data.materials.append(mat_resistor_body)

# Align resistor_2 to substrate
align_face_to_face(resistor_2, substrate, offset_z=0.0025)
# Offset resistor_2
resistor_2.location.x += 0.08
resistor_2.location.y -= 0.04

# 3.3 Create capacitor_1
capacitor_1 = add_primitive("capacitor_1", "cube", size=(0.005, 0.005, 0.004), location=(0,0,0), rotation=(0,0,0))
capacitor_1.data.materials.append(mat_resistor_body) # Using resistor body color as generic passive or specific if defined

# Align capacitor_1 to substrate
align_face_to_face(capacitor_1, substrate, offset_z=0.003)
# Offset capacitor_1
capacitor_1.location.x -= 0.06
capacitor_1.location.y -= 0.04

# 3.4 Create capacitor_2
capacitor_2 = add_primitive("capacitor_2", "cube", size=(0.005, 0.005, 0.004), location=(0,0,0), rotation=(0,0,0))
capacitor_2.data.materials.append(mat_resistor_body)

# Align capacitor_2 to substrate
align_face_to_face(capacitor_2, substrate, offset_z=0.003)
# Offset capacitor_2
capacitor_2.location.x += 0.06
capacitor_2.location.y += 0.04

# SECTION 4 – Create LEDs

# 4.1 Create led_1
led_1 = add_primitive("led_1", "cylinder", diameter=0.004, height=0.003, location=(0,0,0), rotation=(0,0,0))
led_1.data.materials.append(mat_led_red)

# Align led_1 to substrate
align_face_to_face(led_1, substrate, offset_z=0.0025)
# Offset led_1
led_1.location.x -= 0.05
led_1.location.y += 0.06

# 4.2 Create led_2
led_2 = add_primitive("led_2", "cylinder", diameter=0.004, height=0.003, location=(0,0,0), rotation=(0,0,0))
led_2.data.materials.append(mat_led_red)

# Align led_2 to substrate
align_face_to_face(led_2, substrate, offset_z=0.0025)
# Offset led_2
led_2.location.x += 0.05
led_2.location.y -= 0.06

# SECTION 5 – Create Connectors

# 5.1 Create conn_1
conn_1 = add_primitive("conn_1", "cube", size=(0.030, 0.010, 0.008), location=(0,0,0), rotation=(0,0,0))
conn_1.data.materials.append(mat_connector_gold)

# Align conn_1 to substrate
align_face_to_face(conn_1, substrate, offset_z=0.005)
# Offset conn_1
conn_1.location.y -= 0.045

# 5.2 Create conn_2
conn_2 = add_primitive("conn_2", "cube", size=(0.020, 0.010, 0.006), location=(0,0,0), rotation=(0,0,0))
conn_2.data.materials.append(mat_connector_gold)

# Align conn_2 to substrate
align_face_to_face(conn_2, substrate, offset_z=0.005)
# Offset conn_2
conn_2.location.y += 0.045

print("All stages complete.")
